source.note: The registry's own approved boundary document. Not redrawn, not approximated, not sourced from any third party.

registry_metadata_snapshot.states_provinces: Matabeleland North, Midlands, Mashonaland West, Mashonaland Central

artifact_facts.crs: OGC:CRS84 / EPSG:4326 (WGS84 longitude, latitude) — the KML default; no reprojection performed

transformations_applied.detail: Every KML coordinate carried a third value of exactly 0. The GeoJSON is 2D.

All five KML rings are clockwise; RFC 7946 exterior rings are counter-clockwise, and Earth Engine interprets winding on geodesic polygons. The point set of every ring is unchanged and the reversal is verified by round-trip comparison against the KML.

transformations_deliberately_not_applied: No coordinate rounding, simplification or densification.
No repair of the part 1 / part 5 overlap described below.
No dissolve or union of the five parts.
No inward buffer — that is an analysis-time operation per ADR-011 and docs/data/conventions.md.

geometry_validity.method: pure-python ring closure, pairwise segment intersection, range checks

part_overlap.detail: 29 vertices of part 1 fall inside part 5 and 12 of part 5 inside part 1, with no shared vertices — a digitising sliver along a common edge, not a duplicated polygon.
part_overlap.consequence: Area must be computed on the union, not by summing parts. Left as delivered by the registry.

area_cross_check.method: Chamberlain & Duquette spherical-excess area on the WGS84 ellipsoid, summed over parts (union differs by ~0.003%)
area_cross_check.verdict: FAILS the ~10% plausibility threshold in issue #2
area_cross_check.unresolved: The registry's boundary document describes substantially more land than the registry's own area field and than the case YAML. The most likely explanation is a project-area versus project-zone distinction, but that is a hypothesis: it has not been confirmed against the project description, and no figure here has been adjusted to fit it.

notes: ADR-011 builds the treated unit as registry_boundary ∩ mask ⊖ inward_buffer(300 m). A MultiPolygon with five parts is admissible: the mask and buffer apply to the masked geometry as a whole.
The inward buffer must be applied after masking, per ADR-011, so it is not baked into this artifact.
The part 1 / part 5 overlap must be dissolved before any area or zonal computation, or the sliver is counted twice.

The registry names four districts (Binga, Nyaminyami, Hurungwe, Mbire). Whether the GAUL 2015 level-2 units of those names contain these parts is unverified here and belongs to #23, which pins the GAUL asset.

The unresolved area question changes what the treated unit is, and therefore the [1/3x, 3x] eligible-area band that ADR-011 derives from it. It must be settled before the donor pool is generated (#3).

not_verified_here: Whether the geometry lies entirely within Zimbabwe (needs an administrative boundary dataset; #23).
Whether the boundary corresponds to the accounting area used for issuance, or to a wider project zone (needs the project description PDF, PROJ_DESC_902_16AUG2013.pdf, document id 110200000335895).
Any comparison against monitoring-report maps or the CCB project description.
